When I was a kid, I used to think that the food at Steak N Shake was prohibitively expensive, because we only ate there every now and again. Like once a year, tops. I only ever went there a handful of times. But now I realize that was just because my parents blame me for ruining their lives, and they hated to see me have a good time. The food at Steak N Shake is ultra cheap. It might even be cheaper than the food at McDonalds - especially when you factor in the relative quality of what you get. Come to find out, I could have been eating Steak N Shake all the time back in the day. Motherfucker!

I'm actually kinda glad though, just because I don't have a lot of money as an adult (coincidence?), and I can still afford to eat at Steak N Shake as often as I want. I couldn't make myself a hamburger and fries, let alone a delicious milkshake, using crap I bought from the grocery store, for less than the food costs at Steak N Shake. And if I tried to make myself a comparable meal at home, it would be disgusting, because the burgers you make for yourself at home are disgusting compared to the burgers you can buy from a fast food restaurant. That's not just true when you're eight years old. Burgers at fast food restaurants are designed in a laboratory to taste better than anything you could come up with. They also benefit from what's known in business school (which I'll have you know I went to) as economies of scale, so they only cost $1. Grocery stores don't even sell meat in $1-sized packages. I should know, I looked.

A few things I should warn you about at Steak N Shake:

1) Sometimes the drive thru takes forever.

I interviewed for a job there once (#fail), and it was explained to me that this is because your food is made fresh to order. But sometimes I notice my food is ready to go before I can even get around to the window. Hmm...

2) They ask you the most difficult question in life.

Most fast food restaurants, you just pick which burger you want, and that's it - as long as you're not one of these assholes who think they can improve upon millions of dollars worth of R&D by making all sorts of special requests. At Steak N Shake, you pick which burger you want, then they ask you what you want on it. This would be fine, if you could expect most people to have a general idea of what comes on a hamburger and what they usually like on a hamburger. But, alas, you can't. It must be some lingering effect of the crack era. All those babies are now like 26 years old and subsisting on a steady diet of fast food.

All of the burgers at Steak N Shake are more or less the same thing. Some of them they add extra shit like guacamole and chili. You don't want any of that bullshit. Just get the Double Steakburger with Cheese. Some people will insist that the Frisco Melt is the only thing to get from Steak N Shake. I don't find that to be true. To me, it tastes too much like a regular ol' grilled cheese sandwich from an elementary school tray lunch. They should serve it with a side of rancid canned spinach and a mini carton of milk.

Whatever you get, it's the meat that's the kicker. I find calling it a Steakburger a rather specious claim, because if it was served in actual steak form, it probably wouldn't worthy of the $10 t-bone dinner at Miami Grill, a bit further down Page, towards the ghetto. But it really is a cut above what you get at, say, McDonalds. It's a wonder they can afford to charge so little for it.

I placed a delivery order for a taco salad and a side order of fries, I was told that there would be at least 45-50 min wait which I was perfectly okay with. A little over an hour had passed and I called the restaurant to check on my order and spoke with a mr kelly, who told me the driver(Megan)  had just left with my order and should arrive any minute. So i waited, another 40 mins pass by still no driver I call the restaurant once again and mr kelly AGAIN told me that a driver (now named Donna) has my order and should arrive any minute.. AGAIN I waited. After another let's says 15 minutes still no driver I call back obviously upset and wondering why a taco salad and a side order of fries takes 2 hours to be delivered? I tried to speak and say "I know it's Saturday and you guys are probably busy.." but before I could finish what I was going to say, Mr kelly very rudely interrupted me by saying "If you are going to carry on I'm just going to cancel your order!" Who speaks to customers like that when I'm just trying to figure out why my taco salad and fries still aren't here after 2 hours! I am currently disabled and it is hard for me to get around so waiting 2 hours for very simple items upset me and when I finally started to relax again my doorbell rang with a driver there holding a damn PIZZA!!! This is RIDICULOUS.

Your pizza is so fucking good, you have vegan shit too (I appreciate it). 

All so great, I'm just REALLY fucking pissed that you guys only have food and NO fun. Where the fuck is the ball pit, assholes? Where THE FUCK is the arcade. You have food and no fun? I don't respect that. I don't like it at all. If you're gonna act real, then be real, bro. I don't wanna always have to be the one to bring the fun, I want to be where the FUN IS. 

Mic drop, bitch.

Sin duda alguna su producto es de muy buena calidad, al probar sus ricas paletas nos lleva a recordar cuando nos las comiamos al salir de misa los domingos. Es dificil escoger cual es mi favorita, ya que todas las que probado son mis favoritas.  gansito, fresa con kiwi, mango con chamoy, mazapan, fresa de leche, vainilla, chicle, pina con chile, limon, campana, esquimal etc. 

El servicio al cliente es fenomenal y no dudan en nombrar cada sabor de su paleta sin molestia alguna. 

Tambien, sus aguas frescas son riquisimas, y sin duda alguna son de fruta natural y entre mas grande sea el vaso mucho mejor.  

Ya que pruebes sus paletas, no dudaras en volver!

Ok. I've lived nearby for a while now, and Trio's is totally addictive. I am extremely suspicious of some of the outrageous (negative) reviews using words like "disgusting," "worst pizza," etc. that's simply ridiculous. 

Trio's makes some killer pizza. Their salads are great too, sammiches, everything. Their ingredients seem to be very good quality. It's a step up from an average "pizza place" in every way. 

But uh... you can believe that it's horrible, if you want. Less wait time for me.
